root_idea.summary: A forward movement that passes through a barrier or proceeds effectively through a matter.
root_idea.development: The root develops from physical penetration and passage to traversal, reach, access, effective action, execution, and means of egress. Its Quranic Form I use concerns passing beyond encompassing regions or limits.

senses.definition: To pass through or beyond a confining boundary; to penetrate past its limits.
senses.usage_conditions: In 55:33, used of attempting or being unable to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, in the constructions فَانْفُذُوا and لَا تَنْفُذُونَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass through a thing and emerge clear of it; to penetrate from one side to the other.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of physical penetration, including an arrow piercing an animal or a wound passing through. The verbal nouns نَفَاذٌ and نُفُوذٌ denote this passage or penetration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To depart, pass away from a place, or go one's way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in constructions meaning to go from one's position or proceed along one's way.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass through a group of people and leave them behind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a people as the object of passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a road or abode, to be open, passable, or communicating with a road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thoroughfare or of an abode that opens onto and communicates with a road.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of sight, to reach, extend beyond, or penetrate among those seen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction with sight may mean that it reaches beyond a group, extends over all of them, or penetrates into their midst.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of judgment, to be penetrating or perceptive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a judgment characterized by insight and penetration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act or proceed in an affair with penetrative energy, sharpness, vigor, and effectiveness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with فِي الأَمْرِ and similar constructions for effective progress in an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a letter or messenger, to reach or arrive at a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a written communication or messenger passing to its intended recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a command or saying, to take effect and be carried out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when an order or statement becomes effective, is executed, or is obeyed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of emancipation, a covenant, contract, sale, or similar act, to take effect or become operative.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional extension from irreversible passage; used of a legal or transactional act being executed or given effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To judge between parties and make the resulting command or decision effective.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the construction يَنْفُذُ بَيْنَنَا, it denotes adjudicating between the parties and executing the decision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ability, efficacy, or effective power in affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's capacity to carry matters through and execute them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To execute or carry out an order or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II is causative/intensive in relation to making an order effective; its verbal noun is تَنْفِيذٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring someone before a judge or cite him before a judge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the reciprocal legal construction in which one party brings a case before a judge and the other may do likewise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an arrow pierce through an animal and emerge from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the arrow as object, including the construction أَنْفَذْتُ فِيهِ السَّهْمَ, to cause it to penetrate or pass through.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause an order, affair, covenant, or contract to take effect; to execute or accomplish it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used causatively of bringing a command or undertaking into effect, including carrying out an affair or covenant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send or transmit a letter or messenger so that it reaches its recipient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a letter or messenger as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter among or penetrate into a group of people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of becoming among the people or moving through their midst.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For opposing parties to come before a judge and refer their case to him for judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal legal construction involving the parties' pleadings or allegations before the judge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wound or piercing having a passage through to the other side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote the passage itself or the opening made by a piercing wound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place, way, or means of exit, escape, or safety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively for a means of escape from the consequences of an act or statement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The making of a command or order effective; execution or performance of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used substantivally in the sense of إِنْفَاذٌ, including accomplishing what a writing or command contains.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Piercing or passing through from one side to the other.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Of an arrow or wound, describes penetration through an animal or through both sides of the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a road, open, passable, and serving as a thoroughfare.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a road that is not stopped up and along which people may pass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An opening or perforation through which sensation of joy or grief is conveyed to the mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the plural نَوَافِذُ, refers technically to bodily openings such as the ears, nostrils, mouth, and anus.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Penetrating, incisive, energetic, vigorous, and effective in one's affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an epithet of a person, especially in the construction نَافِذٌ فِي أَمْرِهِ or فِي الأُمُورِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a command or order, effectual, operative, executed, or obeyed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used predicatively of an order that has taken effect or is being carried out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular double-sided feather or curl of hair in a horse's coat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine term for a marking occurring on both sides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an affair, arranged or made easy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributive description of an affair that has been put in order or facilitated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of passage, outlet, or route by which people or things pass through.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a passage or thoroughfare, including a road that provides access to a destination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place through which a thing passes; a thoroughfare or place of egress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place noun, with plural مَنَافِذُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ample room, scope, or liberty to act; a means of escape.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of available space or latitude for action and, by extension, an available way out.

cautions: The Quranic form is normalized to the Form I perfect citation headword نَفَذَ, although the three QAC occurrences are imperfect or imperative forms in 55:33.
The Form I Quranic usage is passage beyond encompassing regions; the physical, figurative, and derived-form extensions listed separately are broader Classical Arabic evidence.
